book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from the Thousand and One Nights
book_meta.author: traditional

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: נתתי לו את היין, והוא שתה הרבה מאוד.
sentences.en: I gave him the wine, and he drank a great deal.

sentences.ar: הראש שלו הסתובב, והרגליים שלו נפתחו.
sentences.en: His head spun, and his legs opened.

sentences.ar: הפלתי אותו על האדמה וברחתי משם מהר.
sentences.en: I threw him to the ground and fled from there quickly.

sentences.ar: רצתי לחוף ולא הסתכלתי אחורה אפילו פעם אחת.
sentences.en: I ran to the shore and did not look back even once.

sentences.ar: בחוף פגשתי אנשים מספינה שעצרה למים.
sentences.en: On the shore I met men from a ship that had stopped for water.

sentences.ar: סיפרתי להם על הזקן, והם אמרו שהרבה מתו ככה.
sentences.en: I told them about the old man, and they said many had died that way.

sentences.ar: הם לקחו אותי איתם, ושוב ניצלתי בדרך שלא חשבתי עליה.
sentences.en: They took me with them, and again I was saved by a way I had not thought of.
